title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: invoice deadline, minimum invoice, payment term and dangerous-goods uplift
content:
## Scope

These are the invoice-level settings of each product in the AHL Demurrage and Detention Free Time category: the dangerous-goods uplift on demurrage day rates, the latest day for issuing the final invoice, the minimum invoice total and the payment term.

## Settings per product

| Product | Dangerous-goods uplift on demurrage day rates | Invoice issue deadline | Minimum invoice | Payment term |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Tariff Free Time | 50 percent | 30 calendar days | USD 25.00 | 15 calendar days |
| AHL Free Time Extension 3 | 50 percent | 30 calendar days | USD 25.00 | 15 calendar days |
| AHL Free Time Extension 7 | 50 percent | 30 calendar days | USD 25.00 | 15 calendar days |
| AHL Combined Free Time 14 | 50 percent | 30 calendar days | USD 25.00 | 30 calendar days |
| AHL Combined Free Time 21 | 50 percent | 30 calendar days | USD 25.00 | 30 calendar days |
| AHL Contract Free Time 30 | 25 percent | 30 calendar days | USD 50.00 | 45 calendar days |

## Meaning of each setting

- **Dangerous-goods uplift**: the increase, in whole percent, of demurrage day rates for a container on a booking whose cargo type is dangerous goods.
- **Invoice issue deadline**: the latest the final invoice may be issued, in calendar days after the charges stopped accruing.
- **Minimum invoice**: the total below which no invoice is issued, in USD per record.
- **Payment term**: the payment term of a demurrage and detention invoice, in calendar days counted from the invoice date.

## Points of judgement

**Q: What is the dangerous-goods uplift under AHL Contract Free Time 30?**
A: 25 percent; the other five products carry 50 percent.

**Q: Does the invoice issue deadline differ between products?**
A: No. Every product sets it at 30 calendar days after the charges stopped accruing.

**Q: Which products carry the longest payment term?**
A: AHL Contract Free Time 30, at 45 calendar days from the invoice date; AHL Combined Free Time 14 and AHL Combined Free Time 21 carry 30 and the remaining three products 15.
